title.narrative: RISE – Resilient, Improved and Strengthened Communities
RISE- Rafforzata e migliorata la resilienza delle Comunità

description.narrative: L'iniziativa in favore della Federazione Internazionale di Croce Rossa e Mezzaluna Rossa intende sostenere le comunità nella costruzione della resilienza ai pericoli dei disastri. Nello specifico, mira a garantire che i livelli di preparazione e rapidità delle Società Nazionali siano adeguati per promuovere un'efficace anticipatory action ed una adeguata risposta umanitaria. L’iniziativa, inoltre, si concentra sul rafforzamento della riduzione del rischio di catastrofi a livello comunitario al fine di fornire alle comunità le risorse necessarie per sostenere la resilienza e proteggere i risultati dello sviluppo.

The initiative in favour of the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies aims at supporting communities in building resilience to hazards. Specifically, it aims at ensuring that the levels of preparation and rapidity of the National Societies are adequate to promote effective anticipatory action and an adequate humanitarian response. The initiative also focuses on strengthening community disaster risk reduction as a continuum, aimed at resourcing communities to uphold resilience and protect development gains.

tag.narrative: By 2020, substantially increase the number of cities and human settlements adopting and implementing integrated policies and plans towards inclusion, resource efficiency, mitigation and adaptation to climate change, resilience to disasters, and develop and implement, in line with the Sendai Framework for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015–2030, holistic disaster risk management at all levels

By 2030, build the resilience of the poor and those in vulnerable situations and reduce their exposure and vulnerability to climate-related extreme events and other economic, social and environmental shocks and disasters

By 2030, significantly reduce the number of deaths and the number of people affected and substantially decrease the direct economic losses relative to global gross domestic product caused by disasters, including water-related disasters, with a focus on protecting the poor and people in vulnerable situations
End poverty in all its forms everywhere
Improve education, awareness-raising and human and institutional capacity on climate change mitigation, adaptation, impact reduction and early warning
Make cities and human settlements inclusive, safe, resilient and sustainable
Strengthen resilience and adaptive capacity to climate-related hazards and natural disasters in all countries
Take urgent action to combat climate change and its impacts
